'''Droid enforcement agents''' were specialized [[Police officer/Legends|law enforcement officers]] who dealt with [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-related crime. The agents were tasked with investigating and prosecuting any violations of the [[Droid Statutes]].<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
